body.name: \((\gamma,\beta,\delta,E_M)\)
body.construction: Set \(\gamma_r=\inf_{z\in\mathcal Z_\eta}G_r(z)=G_r(\eta,\ldots,\eta)\), \(\beta=\min_{1\leq j\leq J}\prod_{r=1}^{K}\gamma_r^{M_{jr}}\), \(\delta=\sup_{z\in\mathcal Z_\eta}\lVert\widetilde H(z)-H(z)\rVert_2\), and \(E_M=\lVert M^{+}\rVert_2\delta/(\beta-\delta)\) when \(\delta<\beta\).
